page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c56g1.14xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for compute-intensive and graphics-heavy workloads. It features 56 dedicated physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 346.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 6.18 GB of RAM per core. Graphics and acceleration capabilities are delivered via a single integrated NVIDIA Ampere A10 GPU with 24 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage is not bundled with this instance, meaning external block storage must be attached. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate strong capabilities in cryptographic and decompression tasks. The instance achieved a PassMark CPU score of 51,481.37 and an encryption test score of 47,417.11, both placing in the top 25% tier. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression also demonstrated strong performance at 262.06 GB/sec. In terms of artificial intelligence workloads, the hardware excels in small-to-medium language model execution, achieving top-tier performance with 9,738.91 tokens/sec for 135M model prompt processing and 2,464.01 tokens/sec for 7B model prompt processing. Standard database operations and Redis SET operations perform at average baseline levels, with Redis handling 47.88 million operations per second.

Given the inclusion of a dedicated NVIDIA A10 GPU alongside a high-core Intel Xeon processor, this instance offers a balanced resource density for specialized workloads. The absence of local storage represents a structural tradeoff, requiring users to factor in the cost and performance of network-attached storage. This server is highly suited for workloads such as medium-scale LLM inference, machine learning model training, 3D rendering, and high-throughput database operations that benefit from GPU acceleration and high memory capacity.
